description: Review an outside-counsel invoice against supplied engagement terms and billing guidelines, producing line-item findings and an internal draft approval/rejection note.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.license: Source declarations and all original notices preserved; no license clearance claim.

routing.when_to_use: Review an outside-counsel invoice against supplied engagement terms and billing guidelines, producing line-item findings and an internal draft approval/rejection note.
when_not_to_use: A different, distinct task is requested
An unapproved external effect, final decision, signature or system mutation is required
exclusion_rules: Do not infer legal, company or jurisdiction applicability.
No external effects, filing, signing, source-system mutation or compliance certification.
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized evidence; ask only materially outcome-changing questions; complete separable work

required_inputs.name: invoice_and_lines
required_inputs.description: Invoice ID, currency, billing period, line-item detail and totals.

required_inputs.name: matter_and_firm
required_inputs.description: Matter, law firm, staffing context and approved matter budget.

required_inputs.name: billing_guidelines
required_inputs.description: Current approved billing guidelines and engagement terms.

required_inputs.name: review_system
required_inputs.description: E-billing platform or manual process and available coding.

required_inputs.name: prior_invoice_evidence
required_inputs.description: Comparable invoice IDs or prior decisions, if authorized.

required_inputs.name: scope_and_as_of
required_inputs.description: Applicable scope and as-of date; unknown when unavailable.

expected_outputs.name: legal-lawve-invoice-review-compliance-scott-margetts_work_product
expected_outputs.description: Typed task output with evidence, gaps and owner questions.

forbidden_actions: Unapproved external effects, signatures, filings, legal commitments or source-system mutations
Inventing facts, jurisdiction, legal authority, company policy or approval
Exposure of confidential or personal data outside authorized scope
verification_steps: Every non-compliance flag cites a supplied guideline/term.
Math ties to invoice line amount and rate.
No payment or external rejection communication occurs.
Verify primary legal authority and as-of date or mark the proposition unverified.
completion_criteria: Task-specific output complete or exact blocker identified.
Evidence, source currency and unknowns visible.
known_limitations: Draft/uncertified; structural validation does not prove legal accuracy or task performance.
No live database, external research connector or business-system write assumed.

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source ids and hashes only
